paragraphs.text: Lake Darien is a lake in New Argive , part of the Terisian Isles on the world of Dominaria .

Named for King Darien the Great of Kjeldor , Lake Darien is located on the west side of the Kher Ridges at the edge of the Adarkar Wastes and bordering the Yavimayan colony on New Argive . The large lake is fed by a river running from the Karplusan Mountains .

The lake formed during the Flooding of Terisiare when Raynor Glacier melted, leaving behind a dent in the landscape that was filled with meltwater. In 3245 AR , Xantcha and Ratepe passed by the lake on their journey from the Adarkar Wastes to Koilos .
